missing_information_behavior: Clarify whether the problem is jet lag, shift-work circadian disruption or chronic insomnia and review medicines before any suggestion.
safety_exclusions: Do not recommend melatonin as a default treatment for chronic insomnia.
Do not infer a dose or timing without travel direction, time zones and schedule.
Do not ignore sedation, driving or medication interactions.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy, breastfeeding, epilepsy, anticoagulant use, sedative medicines or significant chronic disease.
Persistent insomnia, excessive daytime sleepiness or suspected sleep apnea.
population_and_context: Adults with jet lag or shift-work-related circadian disruption; melatonin may have selected timing-related uses, but chronic insomnia and general sleep problems are different conditions.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule; timing is context-specific and requires evidence-based protocol and product review.
certainty_and_limitations: NCCIH Melatonin and Sleep Disorders pages summarize evidence limitations and safety; benefits differ by circadian indication and timing, not a generic sleep aid claim. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
